notes.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire - Reveal Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s hard to believe it’s only been a week since we announced Rescue Ops: Wildfire, and we've already passed 25,000 wishlists!

This first week has been incredible — we’re still processing all the love, excitement, and support you’ve shown us. Reading your messages, seeing your posts on social media, and discovering press articles about the game has meant the world to us.

THANK YOU so much!✨

[previewyoutube=KZEHa6LAMCU;full][/previewyoutube]
🧑‍🚒 Grab your gear and answer the call
Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you’ll face unpredictable, large-scale wildfires — solo or in co-op. Use a variety of ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support tools, and more to battle the blaze.

We’re aiming for an Early Access launch in late 2025 or early 2026, so we can gather your feedback and build the best experience possible with you.

🔥 Want to learn more, chat with the dev team, and hang out with some amazing people? Join our Discord!  

Have a great week — and once again:
THANK YOU❤️
